API ReferenceBusiness Insights APICustom ApplicationsGet Custom Apps
Get Custom Apps
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/customapps

Retrieves all custom applications. If id query parameter is provided, returns only that specific application in the array.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
id
int32

Optional Custom App ID to retrieve.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
405
429
500

Custom applications retrieved successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
allApps
singleApp
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32
Example: 101
name
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: <= 128 characters

Example: Salesforce CRM
associatedAppName
string

Associated application name (server-assigned).

Example: Salesforce
associatedAppCategory
string

Associated application category (server-assigned).

Example: CRM
description
string
REQUIRED

Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

Possible values: <= 1024 characters

Example: Tracks all Salesforce CRM traffic
signatures
object[]
REQUIRED
]
